Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer interpreted the information about the sale of 1800 Owens Street as relevant to finding the highest price for a high-rise apartment, when in fact the sale price of $1.08 billion pertained to a commercial property transaction rather than a residential high-rise apartment. WebSurfer did not make a distinction between types of real estate transactions, leading to an incorrect conclusion.
